title: Counit compatibility of the explicit affine spectrum chain map
statement: Let $X,X\prime$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, and $c=(P,N,e_c,e_c\prime,t_c)$ Coordinates for $\phi: L(g\prime)^*K\to K\prime$ [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Put $j=X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$ and $j\prime=X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$. Let $e:Q(j^*P)\simeq Lj^*K$ and $e\prime:Q(j\prime{}^*N)\simeq Lj\prime{}^*K\prime$ be isomorphisms whose inverses equal the derived images of $e_c^{-1}$ and $e_c\prime{}^{-1}$ followed by the pinned counits and the canonical quotient/localization comparison maps. Compose the inverse of the tensor-pullback composition comparison for $(\operatorname{Spec}(g\prime_{\mathrm{top}}),j)$ with the composition comparison for $(j\prime,g\prime)$ transported along inverse-spectrum naturality [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso], and denote its termwise component at $P$ by $a_P$. Then the explicit chain map $t_0=j\prime{}^*t_c\circ a_P$ satisfies $\epsilon_{\operatorname{Spec}(g\prime_{\mathrm{top}}),j^*P}\,Q(t_0)\,e\prime= L(\operatorname{Spec}(g\prime_{\mathrm{top}}))^*(e)\,\phi_0$, where $\phi_0$ is the explicitly transported coefficient morphism [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates].

proof.text: Construct the explicit termwise comparison a and its composite with pullback of c.t, exactly as in the statement.
Use affineSpectrum_composition_counit_square at c.P for the compatibility of the two successive counits with the termwise comparison.

Normalize the two prescribed inverse equations using the identity components of quotientCompQhIso. The proved private categorical transport_representative lemma cancels e and eprime, uses naturality of the derived comparison at c.e.inv, counit naturality at c.t and c.represents, and reassembles the chain map via Q.map_comp.

theorem affineSpectrum_representative_map_eq
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X']
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K') (c : Coordinates g' K K' φ)
    (e : (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj c.P) : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec Γ(X, ⊤))) ≅
      affineSpectrumDerivedObject X K)
    (e' : (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X'.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj c.N) : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec Γ(X', ⊤))) ≅
      affineSpectrumDerivedObject X' K')
    (he : e.inv = (derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv).map c.e.inv ≫
      (derivedPullback X.isoSpec.inv).map
        ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app c.P) ≫
      (counit X.isoSpec.inv).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj c.P) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app _)
    (he' : e'.inv = (derivedPullback X'.isoSpec.inv).map c.e'.inv ≫
      (derivedPullback X'.isoSpec.inv).map
        ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app c.N) ≫
      (counit X'.isoSpec.inv).app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj c.N) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).hom.app _) :
    let a : Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv ⋙
        Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop) ≅
        Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X'.isoSpec.inv :=
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso (Spec.map g'.appTop) X.isoSpec.inv
        ((Spec.map g'.appTop) ≫ X.isoSpec.inv) rfl).symm ≪≫
      Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackCompositionIso X'.isoSpec.inv g'
        ((Spec.map g'.appTop) ≫ X.isoSpec.inv) (Scheme.isoSpec_inv_naturality g').symm
    let t : ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj
      (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj c.P) ⟶
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X'.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj c.N :=
      (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ)).hom.app c.P ≫
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X'.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).map c.t
    (counit (Spec.map g'.appTop)).app
          ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj c.P)) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.Q (C := SheafOfModules.{u}
          (moduleRings (Spec Γ(X', ⊤)).toRingedSpace))).map t ≫ e'.hom =
        (derivedPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop)).map e.hom ≫
          affineSpectrumDerivedMorphism g' K K' φ
